integrity_notes: All-parameter structural proof is given; two reproducibility programs check finite cases. No human or independent external validation is claimed. Bibliographic first-public date follows arXiv version 1 rather than the 2026 journal appearance.
scientific_limitations: Finite incidence posets of simple graphs, with arbitrary diagonal marking; quotient multigraph retains loop and parallel edge tokens. No assertion for arbitrary finite transits. General congruence/archival correspondence is a published premise, not a newly proved theorem.
title: Congruence lattices of marked graph-incidence temporal Heyting algebras
